summary.headline: Bologna Codex 18: Astrological Texts
summary.text: Catalogue entries for Bologna codex 18 covering Astrampsychus' decades, lot-casting notes, astronomical computations for 1446–1460, Persian geomancy attributed to Zanates and translated by Arsenius, planetary body correspondences, astrological omens, Ptolemy's genethlialogical apotelesmatics for male and female children, and Theophilus' material on Orpheus, zodiac types, and magical formulas.
